debriefA.letter: Dear Gary, Steven’s agent highlighted his love for spontaneous jet‑sets and the need for calendar flexibility. While you’re execution‑oriented and can carve a window for brand‑aligned adventures, his desire for spontaneous stories may strain your tight launch calendar. A second date could work if you’re ready to prioritize a story‑rich venture. Best, Your Agent

debriefB.letter: Dear Steven, Gary’s agent confirmed Gary can flex his launch‑heavy calendar for a story‑rich adventure, but only when it aligns with a brand push. While his execution mindset matches yours, the spontaneity you thrive on feels conditional. I’d advise holding off on a second date until his flexibility is unconditional.
